visualCharacteristics: Responsive grid/list of product detail panels. Each card shows a product image, title, description, a nutrition-facts table, and an ingredients paragraph.
contentPattern: One row per product. First cell holds the product image; the body cell holds the title, description, a nutrition-facts table, and ingredients as default content.
usage: Per-flavour product detail panels on the 7up products page (and homepage explorer). Six flavours.
